import { `@lf/email` as email, `@lf/attio` as attio } from adapters
import { acme } from credentials

inbox = connect email
crm   = connect attio using acme

function `Summarise`(m: <inbox-[:Email]->>) {
  inc     = (v: <number>) => v + 1
  shout   = (t: <text>) => Text.upper(t)
  counts  = [1, 2, 3]
  doubled = map(counts, (x) => x * 2)
  bumped  = map(counts, inc)
  both    = inc(inc(3)) + count(doubled) + count(bumped)
  tag     = both > 4 ? shout("big") : "small"
  name    = coalesce(m.Subject, shout(m.Body))
  write crm-[:Companies]-> {
    unique by (`Name`)
    Name:        name
    Description: "${tag} ${both}"
  }
}

import { `@lf/email` as email, `@lf/attio` as attio } from adapters
import { acme } from credentials

inbox = connect email
crm   = connect attio using acme

function `Gather`(m: <inbox-[:Email]->>, n: <number>) {
  pdfs    = m-[a:Attachments WHERE a.`Content Type` == "application/pdf"]->.File
  content = [m.Body, ...pdfs, "end"]
  inline  = [m.Subject, ...m-[a:Attachments]->.File]
  head    = content[0]
  mixed   = Text.join([m.Subject, n], " ")
  write crm-[:Companies]-> {
    unique by (`Name`)
    Name:        m.Subject
    Description: "${head} ${mixed} ${count(inline)}"
  }
}

import { `@lf/email` as email, `@lf/attio` as attio } from adapters
import { acme } from credentials
import { fetchUrl, research, vcUrlRetrieval } from plugins

inbox = connect email
crm   = connect attio using acme

function `Enrich`(m: <inbox-[:Email]->>) {
  linked = vcUrlRetrieval(m.Body)
  deck   = first(linked)
  page   = fetchUrl("https://example.com")
  more   = research(m.Subject, { questions: "what it does, which sector, where it is based" })
  write crm-[:Companies]-> {
    unique by (FUZZY Name)
    Name:          m.Subject
    Description ?: coalesce(more.summary, page, deck.text)
    Domains ?:     more.website
  }
}

import { `@lf/manual` as manual, `@lf/slack` as slack } from adapters
import { team_workspace } from credentials

runs = connect manual
chat = connect slack using team_workspace

type Thesis = <"Consumer" | "Infra" | "Health">

function `Recap`(go: <runs-[:Invocation]->>) {
  theses = members(<Thesis>)
  before = 10
  after  = 4
  delta  = -(after - before)
  lead   = theses[0]
  line   = lead != null ? "${lead}" : ""

  ops = only(chat-[ch:Channels WHERE ch.Name == "ops"]->)
  if (ops == null) { fail("no #ops channel") }
  write ops-[:Messages]-> { Message: "${Text.join(theses, ", ")} / ${line} / ${delta}" }
}

listen to runs-[:Invocations]-> fire `Recap`

asks  = connect ask

function `Probe`(m: <inbox-[:Email]->>) {
  q = write asks-[:Check]-> { Prompt: "Pursue ${m.Subject}?" }
  yes = callback({ write q-[:Response]-> { Answer: true } })
  links = "${q.Url} or ${yes.url}"
}
